$comment: FORM P5 admission, 2026-11-18. kind and concept admit the kinds the client renders (list, detail, form, status, inbox, board, dashboard, map, picker, document); workbench and custom are listed in the schema but not rendered yet, and screen.component is NOT admitted.

declarative.why: names one page, what concept it shows, which columns/fields, a filter and a sort; row access is applied by the platform on top, never widened

notLower.why: which rows a caller may see is enforced by the concept gateway (row rules apply under `where`); a function cannot render a page and the client has no way to widen access

twice.note: screen.live: dsl-conformance-max `suppliers` and ride-hailing (offers, my-ride, active-ride, rides-all, dispatch-board)

enforced.note: probe 19 serves the screens' data under the caller's role; probe 20 shows concept access applies to values an experience asks for; ExperienceValidationTest checks columns (max 7) / fields / where / orderBy against the concept; screen.live is browser-proven (ride-hailing stage 23/23) and client-tested, with no server probe of the SSE stream

taught.bundleLine: `screens[]` says what they see ... `"screens":[{"name":"offers","kind":"list","concept":"RideOffer","columns":["status"],...}]` ... Screen extras: `title`, `where`/`orderBy`/`pick:"first"`/`empty:{"text":".."}`, `live:true` (refresh when rows change)
